finding: Candidate hash and copy are separate reads; destination digest is then freshly accepted rather than compared to the pinned candidate. Bound JSON inputs are also read after their initial hash without final recheck.
correction: Read/hash the exact bytes to be consumed; verify destination against the approved candidate digest; recheck initially bound inputs at completion.

finding: Owned subprocess cleanup calls ACTIVE.wait() without a timeout and skips process-group cleanup if the leader already exited.
correction: Use bounded reap within remaining cleanup allowance, retain errors and descendant/ownership observations, and require outer cgroup termination before acceptance.
